business_problem: Evernorth needed a resilient, isolated data layer and CDC-friendly cloud architecture to modernize critical services without breaking 24/7 operations.
solution_summary: Evernorth adopted MongoDB Atlas as the core data layer for a modernization program that serves about 130 million customer relationships across more than 30 countries and jurisdictions. The architecture follows domain-driven design and microservice principles, giving each service its own private Atlas datastore instead of sharing brittle legacy databases. Each datastore also exposes its own change-data API and streaming interface, while Qlik Replicate and Confluent Kafka move CDC events to and from legacy systems as the company incrementally re-platforms onto AWS. That design simplified migration and validation of critical data, improved fault isolation and resiliency, and let Evernorth move CDC pipelines to the cloud without disrupting downstream consumers.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides an isolated datastore for each microservice in Evernorth's modernized platform.

solution_components.name: Qlik Replicate
solution_components.role: Moves change-data-capture events between Atlas and legacy systems.

solution_components.name: Confluent Kafka
solution_components.role: Streams real-time deltas to and from legacy systems during the migration.

data_flow: Each microservice writes to its own MongoDB Atlas datastore, while Qlik Replicate and Confluent Kafka move CDC events between Atlas and legacy systems so real-time deltas flow without interrupting 24/7 operations.
business_outcome: Evernorth moved CDC pipelines to the cloud with less risk, modernized critical services incrementally, and kept the business running 24/7.

evidence_quotes: MongoDB was chosen as the underlying data platform, which enabled each microservice to have its own private and isolated datastore.

Each datastore was deployed with its own change-data API and streaming interface, allowing real-time deltas to flow to and from legacy systems, via CDC events, facilitated by Qlik's Replicate product and Confluent Kafka.
The use of MongoDB Atlas, coupled with additional tooling from Qlik and MongoDB partner Confluent, helped greatly in simplifying the migration and validation of Evernorth's most critical data.
